spec: Quiet-hour windows are HH:MM-HH:MM, half-open, and may wrap past midnight.
diff:
--- a/master/controller/policy.py
+++ b/master/controller/policy.py
@@ -180,0 +180,10 @@
+def in_quiet_hours(windows, minute):
+    for window in windows:
+        match = QUIET_RE.fullmatch(window)
+        if not match:
+            continue
+        start = int(match[1]) * 60 + int(match[2])
+        end = int(match[3]) * 60 + int(match[4])
+        if start < end and start <= minute < end:
+            return True
+        if start > end and (minute >= start or minute < end):
+            return True
+    return False
